name: Concierge — multi-purpose international voice agent (US/EN via Twilio)
description: A general-purpose, multi-talented English voice agent for international (US/+1) calls over Twilio. The call's PURPOSE is supplied per-dispatch (payload.goal + context), so the same agent can confirm deliveries, follow up on carts, qualify leads, handle post-purchase support, etc. India COD stays on the cod-confirm profile/Vobiz; this is the prepaid-international counterpart.

tools.name: complete_call
tools.description: Goal achieved or the conversation reached its natural end — record the outcome + a short summary.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Customer asked to be called back at a specific time.

tools.name: escalate_human
tools.description: Customer needs a human / situation is out of scope — record for manual follow-up.

triggers.purpose: Generic dispatch — POST a concierge call with a per-call goal + context.
